question: Where can I get a list of hydropower plants and dams in the United States, with location, capacity (MW), reservoir volume, operator and annual generation?

answer.summary: No single official table links hydro plants and dams. EIA-860 (2025) lists 1,457 hydro plants (3,981 conventional and 150 pumped-storage generators) with coordinates, MW and operator; EIA-923 adds 2025 net MWh, negative at many pumped-storage plants. USACE's National Inventory of Dams (CSV updated 2026-11-20; 92,674 rows, 2,529 with a hydroelectric purpose) gives dam location, owner and normal/maximum storage in acre-feet but no MW or EIA code. A coordinate join matched 967 of 1,457 EIA plants within 1 km of an NID hydro dam. ORNL's EHA database sits behind a form.
main_caveats: No common key between EIA plant codes and NID IDs; the coordinate join matched 967 of 1,457 EIA plants within 1 km and is not a published crosswalk.
Counting units differ: EIA = generators/plants (a dam may be two plants, e.g. Hoover NV+AZ); NID = dams and associated structures (Bath County has five rows).
NID gives owners, normal and maximum storage (acre-feet), but no MW, operator or EIA/FERC IDs; hydroelectric purpose is incomplete (Grand Coulee lacks it).
EIA-923 net generation at pumped-storage plants is often negative (22 of 39 plants with pumped-storage generators); do not read it as production.
NID storage definitions (normal includes dead storage; max includes surcharge) were found only on mirrored dictionaries, not USACE's own.
ORNL's EHA plant database was not downloaded: its page requires a Data Use Policy form with personal details.
answer.confidence_reason: EIA-860/923 and NID were downloaded and cross-checked on four facilities and by a measured spatial join; EHA was not opened and NID definitions rest on mirrors.

attributes.note: EIA-860 plant points and NID dam points exist; no published key links a plant to its dams (967 of 1,457 plants have an NID hydro dam within 1 km).
attributes.gap_note: NID and EIA carry no shared identifier; ORNL EHA, which may bridge them, was not downloaded (data-use form). One dam can be several EIA plants (Hoover) and one plant several NID structures (Bath County).

attributes.note: EIA-860 nameplate/net MW per generator for hydro plants of 1 MW or more (conventional 80,061 MW, pumped storage 22,224 MW nameplate).
attributes.gap_note: Plants under 1 MW are not in EIA-860 and NID has no MW column, so NID hydro-purpose dams without an EIA plant nearby (852 of 2,528 are more than 5 km from any EIA hydro plant) have no capacity.

attributes.note: NID Normal, Max and NID Storage in acre-feet and surface area; zero or blank for dams without storage (2,386 of 2,529 hydro rows have normal storage).
EIA-860/923 give the operating company per plant; NID gives owners, not operators (179 of 2,528 hydro rows have no owner).
attributes.gap_note: No operator field for dams; owner/operator differences between associated NID structures and the EIA plant are not published (Conowingo: NID owner blank, EIA operator Constellation Power, Inc).

attributes.note: EIA-923 2025 net generation (MWh) by plant, 1,401 hydro plants; negative totals at many pumped-storage plants; dams without generators have none.

steps: Download the nation CSV; skip the first metadata line.
Match to EIA plants by coordinates (see reading traps) or name and state.
reading_traps: No MW, no operator, no EIA plant code or FERC project number in the 85 columns: EIA and NID must be linked by coordinates or name.

Spatial join measured on 2026-11-20: 967 of 1,457 EIA hydro plants have an NID hydro-purpose structure within 1 km (1,063 within 2 km, 1,172 within 5 km); 1,139 of 2,528 NID hydro-purpose structures lie within 1 km of an EIA hydro plant.
One facility can be many NID rows (Bath County: Upper Reservoir VA017006, Lower Reservoir VA017007, fuse plug, two recreation ponds) and one NID dam can be several EIA plants (Hoover Dam).
Hydro dams missing the purpose: Grand Coulee Dam WA00262 lists 'Flood Risk Reduction;Irrigation' only.
Storage definitions (normal includes dead storage, max includes surcharge) come from mirrored data dictionaries, not USACE.

problems: records_for_country is rows whose Purposes include Hydroelectric (2,528 have coordinates); normal storage > 0 for 2,386 of the 2,529.
USACE data dictionary and API documentation were not located; /api/dictionary returned 404.
